AO NEXUS
Based on AOQuickLauncher by never-knows-best and contributors
Enhanced by Luckyspawn

Original AOQuickLauncher backend: never-knows-best and contributors
https://gitlab.com/never-knows-best/aoquicklauncher
Thank you to the original authors and contributors whose work made this
launcher possible. The backend and LoginHandler.dll are derived from this project.
The upstream checkout used for this package does not contain a separate LICENSE file.

AO Nexus: separate launcher design, original generated backdrop, original portal icon, official server news, and independent profile storage.

Luckyspawn: launcher interface, account/character selection, local preferences
import, presets, shared login-server management, account-specific game folders,
connections, and launcher integration and
customisations.

The Luckyspawn signature does not attribute the original backend or third-party
libraries to Luckyspawn and does not replace their copyright or license terms.

Included dependencies and upstream source projects:

.NET runtime - Microsoft and .NET contributors
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime
The included runtime license and third-party notices are preserved in Licenses.

CommandLineParser - CommandLineParser contributors
https://github.com/commandlineparser/commandline

Reloaded.Injector - Sewer56 and Reloaded Project contributors
https://github.com/Reloaded-Project/Reloaded.Injector

Reloaded.Assembler - Sewer56 and Reloaded Project contributors
https://github.com/Reloaded-Project/Reloaded.Assembler

Reloaded.Memory - Sewer56 and Reloaded Project contributors
https://github.com/Reloaded-Project/Reloaded.Memory

Reloaded.Memory.Buffers - Sewer56 and Reloaded Project contributors
https://github.com/Reloaded-Project/Reloaded.Memory.Buffers

PeNet - Stefan Hausotte and contributors
https://github.com/secana/PeNet
Package metadata identifies the Apache License 2.0:
https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

PeNet.Asn1 - Sergey Savchuk, Jan Jansen, Stefan Hausotte and contributors
https://github.com/secana/asn1
License location recorded by the package:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/secana/asn1/master/LICENCE

Microsoft Research Detours 4.0.1 - Microsoft Corporation
https://github.com/microsoft/Detours
Used by LoginHandler.dll. Its restored package has no separate license file.

flat assembler - Tomasz Grysztar
FASM-LICENSE.TXT is preserved in the embedded backend and in Licenses.

Existing license documents from restored dependency packages are copied into
Licenses, grouped by package name and version. No new license is asserted for
the original AOQuickLauncher code.
